title: CommercialInvoice
description:
A commercial invoice: an itemized account of goods delivered together with a
demand for payment. Based on HeaderTradeSettlement, the UN/CEFACT settlement
facet, which natively carries the invoicer, the invoicee, the amounts and the
payment means. Aligned to the UNVTD commercial invoice
(https://unvtd.unece.org/docs/commercial-invoice/), which assigns the
document no UN/CEFACT class of its own.
See docs/model-guide.md §9 for the property mapping.

invoiceIssuerReference.description: The invoice issuer reference, expressed as text, for this header trade settlement.

payerReference.description: The payer reference, expressed as text, for this header trade settlement.

invoiceNumber.description:
The invoice number, as printed in the document's own heading.
UNVTD `invoiceNumber`.

issueDateTime.description: The date the invoice was issued. UNVTD `invoiceDate`.

invoicerParty.description: The party issuing the invoice and to be paid.

invoiceeParty.description: The party the invoice is addressed to.

notifyParty.description:
The party to be notified of the shipment. UN/CEFACT declares no
notify-party property on any settlement or agreement class.

specifiedTradeProduct.description:
The goods being invoiced: `description` carries the goods row verbatim,
`designation` the grade when the document states one.

packageQuantity.description: The number of packages invoiced, such as the total number of bags.

includedPackaging.description: How the goods are packed, when the document states it.

grossWeightMeasure.description: The gross weight of the consignment.

tareWeightMeasure.description: The tare weight of the consignment.

netWeightMeasure.description: The net weight of the consignment.

price.description: The unit price and the quantity it is quoted against.

totalInvoiceAmount.description: The total value of the invoice, as printed.

duePayableAmount.description:
The amount the invoicee is asked to pay. Kept separate from
`totalInvoiceAmount`: a real invoice can print two different figures.

payeeParty.description: The party payment is due to, when the document names one.

specifiedPaymentMeans.description: The bank details for payment: institution, account, branch and codes.

includedNote.description: Prose with no typed UN/CEFACT slot, discriminated by `subject`.

Date.title: Date
Date.description:
A date carried by a trade document.
`DateValue` is an unconstrained string for now, so it accepts the document's
own wording as well as a normalised form. No `format` is asserted until the
representation is settled.

DateValue.description: The date, as printed on the document or normalised.

TradeParty.title: TradeParty
TradeParty.description:
A party taking a role in a trade document, such as the buyer or the seller.
Only the name is mandatory: sample documents identify counterparties by name
alone, so requiring an address would reject a real document. The address,
role codes, identifiers and contacts are all inherited and optional.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this trade party.

brandName.description: A brand name, expressed as text, for this trade party.

emailURICommunication.description: The email communication for this trade party.

postalAddress.description: The postal address for this trade party.

telephoneCommunication.description: A telephone communication for this trade party.

Quality.title: Quality
Quality.description:
The quality of the goods, verbatim as printed on a document's `Quality` row.
UN/CEFACT has no quality-description property on TradeProduct, so the row's
own label is the honest name.

QualityValue.description: The verbatim text of the `Quality` row.

Quantity.title: Quantity
Quantity.description:
A counted or measured quantity. The unit itself has no home: IUneceQuantityCode
declares no value property, so `QuantityTypeCode` cannot carry "KGM".

Location.title: Location
Location.description:
A place named by a trade document, such as a destination or a place of
payment presentation. Use `locationFunctionTypeCode` to say which.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, of this logistics related location.

postalAddress.description: The postal trade address information for this logistics related location.

Measure.title: Measure
Measure.description:
A measured value such as a weight. The unit itself has no home:
IUneceMeasureCode declares no value property, so `MeasureTypeCode` cannot
carry "kgs".

Price.title: Price
Price.description:
A unit price: the amount, and the quantity that amount is quoted against.
The basis is not the packing unit — a contract can price per 50 kg on 60 kg
bags, and dropping the basis makes any total wrong.

unitAmount.description: The price amount and its currency.

basisQuantity.description: The quantity the amount is quoted against.

Quantity.title: Quantity
Quantity.description:
A counted or measured quantity. The unit itself has no home: IUneceQuantityCode
declares no value property, so `QuantityTypeCode` cannot carry "KGM".
